name: Nijino Yumeha
source:
A girl who has just enrolled at the all-girls boarding school, Tensei Academy for Girls.

She’s cheerful, a little clumsy, and full of energy—never one to give up. Always optimistic, she overflows with dreams and hope.
Though she occasionally gets discouraged, she quickly bounces back thanks to her relentlessly positive mindset. She's your textbook main heroine type.

Sometimes, her mind slips into a world of fantasy (or delusion), and once she's in, she won’t come back to reality until someone calls her out of it.


"That takes me back... I’ve grown distant from her now, but what was her name again…?"
